snippet.title: An Eggstremely Hard Game - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Two geese. One fragile egg. Infinite chaos. 🥚

Get ready for an Eggstremely Hard game, a chaotic co-op physics game where you and a friend must carry a fragile egg across absurd obstacle courses — every bump, fall, and honk counts!
The more the egg cracks, the harder (and funnier) the game becomes. Can your friendship survive the chaos?

🎯 Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4112070
📱 Follow us for updates: https://x.com/BBear_Studio
